title: Orbweaver book
description: A book bundle's `book.yaml`: metadata plus the contents tree that references topic files and arranges them into chapters and sections. Paths are relative to the bundle folder `assets/books/<id>/`.

book.description: Book metadata and its contents tree (the map).

id.description: Book id; must equal the bundle folder name and appear in `assets/books/index.yaml`.

cover.description: Cover image filename in the bundle folder, e.g. `cover.png`.

font_family.description: Body typeface for the whole book; must be a font the app bundles (`RobotoCondensed`).

view.description: `index` = a single-page directory of every topic instead of the drill-down table of contents.

contents.description: The map: ordered leaves and groups.

palette.description: Palette overrides, role → colour, inherited by everything below this level. See topic.schema.json for the role names.

node.description: A contents entry: a LEAF `{topic: <path>}`; a GROUP with a `title` and `children` (a chapter/section, optionally with its own overview `topic`); or a `view: collection` group that renders a `formulary`.

title.description: Chapter/section title; fold the outline number in, e.g. `6.2 Malaria`.

topic.description: Path, relative to the bundle folder, of this group's own overview page.

font_family.description: Body typeface for this subtree; must be a font the app bundles (`RobotoCondensed`).

appendix.description: Reference appendix (drugs/peds/procedures) rather than a numbered section; the `index` book view renders it as a footer bar.

group_collection.description: A `view: collection` group: renders a formulary instead of children.

title.description: Chapter/section title; fold the outline number in, e.g. `6.2 Malaria`.

topic.description: Path, relative to the bundle folder, of this group's own overview page.

font_family.description: Body typeface for this subtree; must be a font the app bundles (`RobotoCondensed`).

appendix.description: Reference appendix (drugs/peds/procedures) rather than a numbered section; the `index` book view renders it as a footer bar.

view.description: `collection` = a faceted formulary (A–Z / by class / by indication) built from `formulary` instead of a chapter.

formulary.description: Path, relative to the bundle folder, of the `formulary.yaml` this collection renders.

topic.description: Path, relative to the bundle folder, of the topic file, e.g. `topics/intro.yaml`.
